profile.title: BSD 3-Clause "New" or "Revised" License
profile.description: A permissive license similar to the BSD 2-Clause License , but with a 3rd clause that prohibits others from using the name of the copyright holder or its contributors to promote derived products without written consent.
profile.how: Create a text file (typically named LICENSE or LICENSE.txt) in the root of your source code and copy the text of the license into the file. Replace [year] with the current year and [fullname] with the name (or names) of the copyright holders.

evidence.locator: text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted")
text: opening grant and conditions 1-3 (permission is non-reciprocal; no same-license, source-disclosure, or corresponding-source condition is stated)
text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted"; no field-of-use limitation is stated)
text: conditions 1-2 (source redistributions must retain, and binary redistributions must reproduce, the copyright notice, list of conditions, and following disclaimer)
text: conditions 1-2 (notice-retention/reproduction duties are activated by source or binary redistribution; modification alone has no separate condition)

text: condition 3 (copyright-holder and contributor names may not endorse or promote derived products without specific prior written permission); final disclaimer paragraph (warranty disclaimer and limitation of liability)
text: complete license text; no express patent grant, patent condition, patent-claim restriction, or patent-termination clause is stated
text: conditions 1-2 require retaining/reproducing the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in source and binary redistributions
